subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` permanently fail closed for legacy ownerless session rows, or should upgrades provide an explicit operator-controlled ownership migration?
rationale: Ownerless rows have no authenticated plugin authority, so automatic adoption would weaken isolation; unconditional rejection is safer but can break previously working plugin-runtime operations after upgrade.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime mutation of ownerless rows and document that operators or non-plugin clients must manage or migrate them.

options.title: Add operator migration
options.body: Provide an explicit doctor or operator-controlled process that assigns ownership before plugin-runtime mutation is permitted.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime mutation of ownerless rows and document that operators or non-plugin clients must manage or migrate them.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical investigation most directly documents the security invariant and the consequences of ownerless session authority.
